title: Hindi mein AI use karna 13.7x mehenga kyun?

source.title: The Indic Token Tax in 2026: Measuring Tokenizer Disparity and Its Cost for the Languages of India

hook.caption: Same sawal, same AI — par Indian language mein poochhne pe 13.7x zyada tokens lagte hain! Nayi 2026 arXiv study ne khola secret 'Token Tax'.
hook.tts: Same सवाल, same AI — पर Indian language में पूछने पर तेरह point सात गुना ज़्यादा tokens लगते हैं! नई 2026 arXiv study ने खोला secret Token Tax.

doc.name: The Indic Token Tax in 2026 (arXiv:2611.13058)
doc.caption: Research Paper: 9 public tokenizers (GPT-4o, Qwen2.5, DeepSeek-V3, Sarvam) tested across 25 Indian languages & 13,732 Hinglish pairs.
doc.tts: यह 2026 arXiv research paper नौ public tokenizers को पच्चीस भारतीय भाषाओं और तेरह हज़ार Hinglish pairs पर test करता है.

points.title: GPT-4o: 1.57x Hindi to 13.7x Santali
points.quote: On GPT-4o's tokenizer the same content needs between 1.57 times (Hindi) and 5.01 times (Odia) the tokens of English, and 13.7 times for Santali in Ol Chiki script; GPT-4's tokenizer needs up to 12.8 times.
points.decoded: Hindi 1.57x, Odia 5.01x, Santali 13.7x zyada tokens vs English
points.caption: Point 1: GPT-4o pe same content ke liye Hindi mein 1.57x, Odia mein 5.01x aur Santali (Ol Chiki) mein 13.7x zyada tokens lagte hain!
points.tts: पहला point. GPT-4o पर same content के लिए Hindi में 1.57x, Odia में 5.01x और Santali में 13.7x ज़्यादा tokens लगते हैं.

points.title: Real Bill Shock: ₹56,640 vs ₹1,02,829
points.quote: In an illustrative scenario using official list prices accessed on 5 November 2026 and stated assumptions, a support bot handling 100,000 chats a month on GPT-4o would cost about INR 56,640 in English and INR 102,829 in Marathi; these are estimates, not measured production costs.
points.caption: Point 2 (Asli Jhatka): 1 lakh chats/month wale support bot ka estimated bill English mein ₹56,640 aur Marathi mein ₹1,02,829 — lagbhag double!
points.tts: पर असली झटका bill देखकर लगता है. एक लाख chats वाले support bot का खर्च English में छप्पन हज़ार, और Marathi में एक लाख दो हज़ार से ज़्यादा!

points.title: Sarvam-30B/105B Beats Western Models
points.quote: Sarvam-30B/105B is the only third-party tokenizer that stays below 2.6 times on every language (median 1.53).
points.decoded: Sarvam-30B/105B har Indian language pe 2.6x se neeche (median 1.53)
points.caption: Point 3: 9 tokenizers mein sirf Sarvam-30B/105B har bhasha pe 2.6x se neeche raha (median 1.53) — warna context window bhi jaldi bharta hai.
points.tts: तीसरा point. नौ tokenizers में सिर्फ Sarvam-30B/105B हर भाषा में 2.6x से नीचे रहा, वरना context window भी जल्दी भर जाता है.

lines: Indian languages = zyada tokens, slow speed, 2x bill
